hypotheses.transfer: The same constrained two-gate update is learnable independently for all three canonical HH channels.
hypotheses.identifiability: Rate supervision improves latent inf/tau fidelity compared with transition-only supervision on paired streams.
hypotheses.capacity_budget: Checkpoint ladders and width16/32 distinguish insufficient optimization from insufficient capacity.
hypotheses.numerical_reference: Linear LUT2049 provides an accurate in-support numerical reference, without an extrapolation or hardware-speed claim.

limits: No weight sharing (reserved for Task22); no full-neuron causal substitution of Na/K; no assumption that held V suffices for a varying 1ms voltage path.
selection: Per channel/objective/seed choose width/checkpoint using only development normalized gate+inf+logtau score. Freeze all checkpoint hashes before materializing fresh tuples. Task19 authorized only if all rate-supervised seeds pass in-support for all channels. Extrapolation is diagnostic, not silently pooled.
native_oracle_tolerance: scaled rate and gate errors<1e-7; zero-conductance voltage drift<1e-8mV; canonical fixed qt and singular perturbations retained
negative_control: transition_only excludes direct rate labels from its training objective, but has identical numeric forward inputs and initialization
stage: original roadmap Task18, ActIII; prerequisite Task17f GateC pass
